## Description

Proposed geometry-aware approach to neural-operator forecasting: Learn a mapping from market-state histories or feature fields to a forecast or allocation output; the predicted variable, forecast horizon, and validation protocol must be defined. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
